name: Israel

flag.description: A white field with two horizontal blue stripes, one near the top and one near the bottom, and a blue Star of David in the centre.
flag.symbolism: The stripes are modelled on the tallit (Jewish prayer shawl), and the Star of David is a long-standing symbol of Judaism.

hook: Israel is a white flag with two blue stripes like a prayer shawl and a blue Star of David between them.
trivia: The design was used by the Zionist movement from the late 19th century, including at the First Zionist Congress in 1897.
The shore of the Dead Sea, on Israel's eastern border, is the lowest land elevation on Earth, more than 400 metres below sea level.
